script.js

JavaScript
let watchSeconds = 0;
let timer = null;

const video = document.getElementById("courseVideo");
const watchTimeText = document.getElementById("watchTime");

if (video) {
  video.addEventListener("play", function () {
    timer = setInterval(function () {
      watchSeconds++;
      watchTimeText.innerText = "Watch Time: " + watchSeconds + " seconds";
      localStorage.setItem("part20WatchTime", watchSeconds);
    }, 1000);
  });

  video.addEventListener("pause", function () {
    clearInterval(timer);
  });

  video.addEventListener("ended", function () {
    clearInterval(timer);
  });
}

const savedWatchTime = document.getElementById("savedWatchTime");

if (savedWatchTime) {
  const savedTime = localStorage.getItem("part20WatchTime") || 0;
  savedWatchTime.innerText = "Total Watch Time: " + savedTime + " seconds";
}

function login() {
  const username = document.getElementById("username").value;
  const password = document.getElementById("password").value;
  const message = document.getElementById("loginMessage");

  if (username === "builder" && password === "1234") {
    message.innerText = "Login successful!";
    window.location.href = "dashboard.html";
  } else {
    message.innerText = "Wrong login.";
  }
}

🔥 Add THIS to script.js

JavaScript
function handleUpload() {

  const title = document.getElementById("title").value;
  const description = document.getElementById("description").value;
  const video = document.getElementById("videoFile").files[0];
  const asset = document.getElementById("assetFile").files[0];
  const type = document.getElementById("courseType").value;
  const status = document.getElementById("uploadStatus");

  if (!title || !video) {
    status.innerText = "Title and video are required.";
    return;
  }

  // Fake upload simulation (for now)
  status.innerText = "Uploading...";

  setTimeout(() => {
    status.innerText = "Upload complete (LOCAL DEMO ONLY)";
    
    // Save basic data locally
    const course = {
      title: title,
      description: description,
      videoName: video.name,
      assetName: asset ? asset.name : "None",
      type: type
    };

    let courses = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("courses")) || [];
    courses.push(course);
    localStorage.setItem("courses", JSON.stringify(courses));

  }, 2000);
}

Replace your CSS with this version. It is set up for:

image/background.png

CSS
* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: Impact, Haettenschweiler, "Arial Black", sans-serif;
    background: #05080c;
    color: white;
}

/* MAIN HEADER HERO */
header {
    min-height: 720px;
    padding: 25px 40px;
    text-align: center;
    background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.25), rgba(0,0,0,0.95)),
        url("image/background.png");
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    border-bottom: 4px solid #39ff14;
}

/* SMALL TOP TITLE */
header h1 {
    color: #39ff14;
    letter-spacing: 10px;
    font-size: 32px;
    margin: 20px 0 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-shadow: 0 0 15px #39ff14;
}

/* BIG HERO TEXT */
.hero h2 {
    font-size: 90px;
    line-height: 0.95;
    margin: 35px 0 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: white;
    text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000, 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
}

.hero h2 span {
    color: #39ff14;
    text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000, 0 0 25px #39ff14;
}

.hero p {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    font-size: 22px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(57,255,20,0.5);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(57,255,20,0.5);
}

/* TOP NORMAL NAV */
nav {
    margin-top: 25px;
}

nav a {
    color: #39ff14;
    margin: 0 15px;
    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    font-size: 18px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px #39ff14;
}

nav a:hover {
    color: white;
}

/* IMAGE NAV CARDS LIKE X-RAY / SPEED BOOST */
.feature-nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 45px auto 20px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.feature-link {
    width: 210px;
    height: 140px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: white;
    background: #111;
    border: 2px solid #39ff14;
    clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 100% 0, 90% 100%, 0% 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(57,255,20,0.45);
}

.feature-link img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    opacity: 0.75;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

.feature-link span {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    padding: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.95));
    font-size: 18px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000;
}

.feature-link:hover img {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1.08);
}

.feature-link:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px #39ff14;
}

/* BUTTON */
.btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 14px 30px;
    background: #39ff14;
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(57,255,20,0.8);
}

/* SECTIONS */
section {
    padding: 40px;
}

section h2 {
    color: #39ff14;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px #39ff14;
}

.course-card,
.form-box {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
    margin: 20px;
    padding: 22px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(57,255,20,0.55);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}

/* COURSE PAGE */
.course-layout {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: auto;
}

/* FORMS */
.form-box {
    max-width: 500px;
    margin-top: 20px;
}

.form-box input,
.form-box textarea,
.form-box select {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    padding: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #39ff14;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #050505;
    color: white;
}

.form-box textarea {
    height: 120px;
}

.form-box button {
    background: #39ff14;
    color: black;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    border: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* MOBILE */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    header {
        min-height: 600px;
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .hero h2 {
        font-size: 48px;
    }

    header h1 {
        font-size: 22px;
        letter-spacing: 5px;
    }

    .feature-link {
        width: 160px;
        height: 110px;
    }
}
